title: Feri Akhir Ke Lumut
mood: patient, longing, rain on still water
subject: a woman waiting at the Lumut jetty in the rain for the last ferry from Pangkor carrying her husband home from his week at the fish-drying yard
caption: Irama asli, the slow traditional Malay asli rhythm song as sung in JKKN Bintang Asli competitions. A Malay violin playing ornamented slides and grace notes around the melody; an accordion holding sustained chords; rebana and gendang marking the slow asli rhythm cycle; a soft gong closing each cycle. Acoustic and roomy, violin and voice forward, gong low and soft, natural hall reverb. Female voice, mid register, with traditional Malay melismatic cengkok ornaments and unhurried phrasing. 66 BPM, A minor. Patient and longing, rain on still water. No drum kit, no synths, no autotune, no pop ballad piano, no dangdut beat.
lyrics:
[Intro - violin and accordion, rebana enters]

[Verse 1]
Hujan turun di jeti Lumut
Payung biru di tangan kiri
Feri pukul tujuh tak nampak lagi
Lampu Pangkor pun samar-samar

[Chorus]
Feri akhir, feri akhir
Bawalah dia pulang malam ini
Seminggu jemur ikan di Pangkor
Bau masin di baju, aku tak kisah

[Verse 2]
Penjual keropok dah tutup kedai
Tinggal aku dengan bangku basah
Telefon dia habis bateri
Aku hafal bunyi enjin feri

[Chorus]
Feri akhir, feri akhir
Itu dia, lampu dah dekat
Topi lusuh di atas dek
Tangannya melambai, aku dah nampak

[Outro - violin and gong]
Payung biru, cukup untuk berdua
Jom balik, nasi masih panas
